personality_one_liner: A high-tension, arcade-thriller interface built for fast scanning, psychological pressure, and tactical utility.

spacing.rule: Use tight, technical spacing for HUD elements and generous spacing around the main button to isolate it.

do's: Use blur behind HUD elements (elimination feed, ability indicators) to maintain background visibility.
Use glass for the bottom tab bar over the main menu backdrop.
dont's: Never blur the central Panic Button itself; it must remain sharp and highly visible.
Avoid glass on dense statistics cards.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Player login/registration with a moody, high-stakes introduction.
screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract red tension background. Centered login form in a surfaceSecondary card. Large, highly visible 'Enter Arena' button.

screens.name: Main Menu (Play)
screens.purpose: Lobby hub showing current rank, equipped ability, and the primary 'Find Match' action.
screens.layout: Background: Dark red abstract texture. Top: Player Profile & Rank tier. Center: Character/Avatar outline or large tension graphic. Bottom: Massive sticky 'Find Match' button floating above the tab bar.

screens.name: Match Screen
screens.purpose: The live battlefield HUD focusing absolute attention on the central button and the rising tension.

states.loading: Lobby fill screen with remaining player count.

screens.layout: Corner-anchored HUD. Top-left: Live Elimination Feed (small, glass background). Top-right: Remaining Players & Kill Count. Top-center: Huge 'Danger Meter' percentage (scaling in size/color as it rises). Center: The massive PANIC BUTTON. Bottom-center: Equipped Ability button (circular, distinct from main button).

screens.name: Abilities
screens.purpose: Browse, unlock, and equip single-use match abilities.
screens.layout: 2-column grid of ability cards. Each card shows an icon, title, and lock/equip status. Selected ability opens a bottom sheet with detailed stats (Second Chance, Deflect, etc.) and an 'Equip' CTA.

screens.name: Cosmetics
screens.purpose: Customize button skins, titles, profile icons, and effects.
screens.layout: Horizontal segmented control (Skins, Titles, Icons, Effects). 3-column grid of visual items. Selecting an item previews it on a mock central button. Sticky 'Equip' button at bottom.

screens.name: Statistics
screens.purpose: Display lifetime player performance and ranks.

states.empty: Play a match to reveal stats.

screens.layout: Dashboard layout. Top: Large Rank Tier card with XP progress bar. Below: 2-column grid of metric cards (Wins, Win Rate, Eliminations, Self-Eliminations) using condensed, large display fonts for numbers.

screens.name: Results
screens.purpose: Victory or elimination summary with suspenseful reveal.
screens.layout: Full-bleed screen. If eliminated: Red tint, 'ELIMINATED BY [PLAYER]' in huge text. If victory: Golden/Amber tint, 'LAST ALIVE'. Followed by XP gain breakdown and 'Return to Lobby' CTA.

button_texture_default.alt: Large red arcade button being pressed

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '7 Dark-First Utility DARK' personality. Use sharp corners (radius sm/md), dark tonal surfaces, and zero drop shadows. Elevation is handled via surface lightness and dividers.

The Danger Meter on the Match Screen must be the second most prominent element after the button. Use the 'Barlow Condensed' font. As the percentage increases, interpolate the color from white to brandSecondary (Amber) to brandPrimary (Red).
The central Panic Button should be a massive Pressable component. Use reanimated to give it a satisfying, deep 'squish' scale animation on press. Integrate 'heavy' haptics on every press.

For the Match Screen HUD, strictly anchor elements to the corners (Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Center) to leave the center completely clear for the Danger Meter and the Panic Button. Use glass overlays (`surfaceSecondary` with blur) for HUD backgrounds to preserve context.
Implement the Gradient Scrim pattern behind any text placed over the `auth_bg` or `main_menu_bg` images to ensure perfect readability.
Do NOT use any blues, indigos, or purples anywhere in the app. Stick strictly to the obsidian/graphite base with signal red and amber accents.
All numbers (XP, Danger %, Remaining Players, Stats) must use 'Barlow Condensed'. All readable UI text (labels, buttons, descriptions) must use 'IBM Plex Sans'.
